name: Database & cache
description: Postgres statement latency and Redis memory pressure

panels.title: Avg statement (ms)
panels.query: cairnobs.metrics!=true cairnobs.heartbeat!=true service=postgres | stats avg(duration_ms) as avg_duration_ms

panels.title: Statements by kind
panels.query: cairnobs.metrics!=true cairnobs.heartbeat!=true service=postgres | stats count by query_kind | sort -count

panels.title: Slowest tables (avg ms)
panels.query: service=postgres | stats avg(duration_ms) as avg_duration_ms by table | sort -avg_duration_ms | head 10

panels.title: Statement kind by table
panels.query: cairnobs.metrics!=true cairnobs.heartbeat!=true service=postgres | stats count by table, query_kind

panels.title: Redis events by operation
panels.query: cairnobs.metrics!=true cairnobs.heartbeat!=true service=redis | stats count by op | sort -count

panels.title: Slowest statements
panels.query: service=postgres | where duration_ms>1000 | sort -duration_ms | head 50 | fields timestamp, table, query_kind, duration_ms, message
